{{Quote|Fett's ship ''Slave I'' was badly damaged. The safest place to make repairs was on the ''Imperial Enclave'' on ''Gall'' &mdash; It being heavily fortified.|[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]|<ref name="Shadows of the Empire 2">[[Shadows of the Empire 2|''Shadows of the Empire'' 2]]</ref>}}
'''Gall''' was a terrestrial [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Zhar/Legends|Zhar]] in the [[Zhar system]]. 

==Geography==
The moon was home to violent planetary and atmospheric storms.<ref name="The Secrets of Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire">''[[The Secrets of Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire]]''</ref>

The moon was dotted by forests and canyons. One such canyon, the [[Smuggler's Canyon]], was the location of an [[Cadavine Sector Fleet Imperial Enclave|Imperial Enclave]]. It had a population of 57 million, mainly [[Human/Legends|Humans]].<ref name="SOTES" /> A species of bioengineered [[Cliff wampa|Wampa]] were known to inhabit the canyon.<ref name="SEgame">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (video game)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' video game]]</ref>

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] Gall was the location of a naval supply depot and factories that made parts for [[Rothana Heavy Engineering/Legends|Rothana Heavy Engineering]]. The factories were overseen by the clan of Cacique [[Jans Coorsa]]. The [[Council of Elders (Gall)/Legends|Council of Elders]] decided to secede from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and join the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. The Republic couldn't afford to lose such an important planet and lay [[Siege of Gall|siege]] to the planet. Jans Coorsa led the resistance against the Republic and gained the nickname 'Phantom of Gall' for his ability to plan complex operations and correctly guess Republic responses. The resistance continued even when the Republic turned into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The Empire managed to find out the identity of the 'Phantom of Gall' and [[Massacre on Gall|massacred]] Coorsa's village.<ref name="Friends" />

Prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Gall contained a [[Regional Naval Supply Area]] used by the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] to resupply ships assigned to oversee construction of the first [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]].

Following a dogfight with [[IG-88D/Legends|IG-88D]] over [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]] granted [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] access to the ship docks of the Enclave to repair the [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']].<ref name="Shadows of the Empire 1">[[Shadows of the Empire 1|''Shadows of the Empire'' 1]]</ref> [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] hired [[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar]] to [[Battle of Gall|scout out]] the Smuggler's Canyon in search of the rogue bounty hunter, who was still carrying his hostage and prize, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]. Rendar made his way through the station and located Fett's hangar bay, where he damaged ''Slave I'', requiring Fett to stay on the moon longer.<ref name="SEgame" />

This gave the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] an advantage. The [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] moved into the system and settled on [[Kile]], from where they engaged the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. During the diversion, Dash led the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] to Fett, where he abandoned his allies.<ref name="Shadows of the Empire 2">[[Shadows of the Empire 2|''Shadows of the Empire'' 2]]</ref><ref name="Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire Galoob minicomic">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire Galoob minicomic|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' Galoob minicomic]]</ref><ref name="Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire novel">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref>
